# discord_ban (Resource)

Bans a user from a server. The user does not need to be a member; a member is removed from the server. Destroying the resource lifts the ban. If the ban is lifted outside Terraform the user is banned again on the next apply. Requires the `BAN_MEMBERS` permission.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "discord_ban" "spammer" {
  server_id              = var.server_id
  user_id                = "456789012345678901"
  reason                 = "Spam"
  delete_message_seconds = 86400
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (String) ID of the server (guild).
- `user_id` (String) ID of the user to ban.

### Optional

- `audit_log_reason` (String) Reason recorded in the server's audit log for lifting the ban, and for the ban itself when `reason` is not set, overriding the provider's `audit_log_reason`. Up to 512 characters. Changing only this argument updates state without calling Discord.
- `delete_message_seconds` (Number) Number of seconds of the user's message history to delete when banning, from 0 to 604800 (7 days). Defaults to 0. Only used when the ban is created; changing it later updates state without calling Discord, and it is not read back or imported.
- `reason` (String) Reason for the ban, shown in the server's ban list and audit log. Up to 512 characters. Discord takes the ban reason from the audit log reason of the request that creates the ban, so when this is not set the ban records `audit_log_reason` or the provider's `audit_log_reason`, and this attribute reports it. Discord cannot change the reason of an existing ban, so changing it lifts the ban and bans the user again.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `server_id/user_id`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = discord_ban.spammer
  identity = {
    server_id = "234567890123456789"
    user_id   = "456789012345678901"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `server_id` (String) ID of the server (guild).
- `user_id` (String) ID of the banned user.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import discord_ban.spammer <server_id>/<user_id>
```
